desc:
🏙️ Build your dream neon megacity—from your first street to a glowing skyline.

Neon Districts: City Builder 2 puts you in charge of a growing cyberpunk city. Design neighborhoods, solve traffic jams, and watch your streets come alive.

🛣️ Build roads, highways, and custom interchanges.
🏗️ Grow neighborhoods and unlock new buildings as your population rises.
🚆 Keep people moving with buses, trains, underground metro, and elevated monorail.
⚡ Balance taxes, utilities, and essential city services.
🌊 Shape the terrain, carve rivers, and expand your city.
💾 Save your progress and return to keep building.

Every road changes how your city moves. Every neighborhood brings your skyline closer to life.

How big can you build?

🚧 Currently in beta, with more improvements on the way.
